focus: access hardening, audited role login and role-aware Web UI

roles.admin: full control including panic, network, users and service operations

behavior.web_role_gate: forbidden controls disabled and capture-blocked before dispatch

regression_guards: Direct HTTP calls cannot bypass service reset authorization.
Login accepts valid Admin, User and Guest identities without granting extra command permissions.
Browser role gating is backed by server-side authorization on every protected command.
